dedupe_keys.name: manabi earthquake debris recycling and scrap business recovery survey

description: This workbook documents recovered and reused materials after the 16 April 2016 earthquake in Manabi province, Ecuador. Elvira Rodriguez Rios and collaborators surveyed sixty-two small and medium scrap businesses in five affected cantons in 2019. The data compare recovered plastic, metal, paper, glass and other materials with pre-earthquake 2015 quantities and 2019 conditions. They also describe recycling stages, delays before purchasing disaster materials and business earnings or perceptions. Mendeley version 1 provides a single XLSX file free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is the surveyed scrap businesses, not every debris stream or disposal facility in the earthquake zone. Retrospective reporting and business selection are limitations for material-balance estimates. Modellers could parameterise recycling capacity, recovery timing or actor participation in post-disaster waste simulations. platform-epa-i-waste is a related planning resource in another jurisdiction. No business-level responses or material quantities were downloaded, and financial reports were not independently checked.
